candidate.crafted_int16_input: guard refused (1 call, 0 CSR returned) and original fallback executed; identical incidence counts

findings.severity: medium (upstream-inherited, NOT introduced by this campaign)
findings.finding: Topology._get_gdf calls gpd.read_file(engine='pyogrio', use_arrow=True) but pyarrow is not a declared dependency. In a truly clean venv, AddNetwork raises RuntimeError('pyarrow required...'). Both wheels affected identically (identical Topology.py).
findings.handling: pyarrow provisioned explicitly in both qualification venvs before the writers proof; recorded here as an environment note and as a recommendation for a follow-up upstream PR (declare pyarrow or drop use_arrow). No packaging change was made in this campaign (would alter metadata beyond the CSR optimization).

no_new_install_steps: candidate wheel installs and runs with exactly the baseline dependency set; no extra steps beyond the upstream pyarrow gap noted above
